_comment: Pinned Obsidian community plugins. Install/refresh with: python3 tools/obsidian_plugins.py  (add --latest to re-pin). Folder name == plugin id == manifest.json id.

obsidian-latex-suite.why: fast LaTeX: snippets, auto-fractions, matrix shortcuts, tab-out (_obsidian/latex-suite/snippets.js)

obsidian-git.why: commit / pull / push from inside the vault; auto-commit timer

table-editor-obsidian.why: aligned pipe tables, Tab/Enter navigation, sort, formulas

obsidian-spaced-repetition.why: ==cloze== and :: flashcards for boxed results and traps (opt-in per note with #flashcards)

obsidian-tasks-plugin.why: the pending-chapter queue and Part 14 checkpoints as live task lists

obsidian-excalidraw-plugin.why: hand-drawn physics diagrams (ray diagrams, FBDs, circuits) exported as SVG into assets/figures/
